start.einleitung: This page guides you through the setup. Work through the steps from top to bottom. Logistik Map checks by itself what is done and shows what is missing – with a link straight to the right place.
start.fertig: Everything is set up. This page keeps checking: if a floor or a delivery without a route is added, it shows up here.
start.nur_admin: Only an administrator can set the federal state.
start.erst_oben: The results are only reliable once the steps above are done.
start.optional_hilfe: Not needed for planning, but useful for running it in your organisation.

benutzer.text: For example viewers for ward managers or planners for logistics.

ad.text: Staff sign in with their Windows account.

https.text: Encrypted connection with a certificate from your IT department.

bundesland.text: Public holidays depend on it. Deliveries with the rule “not on public holidays” are skipped on those days.

gebaeude.text: Add each building section, for example House A and House B, and its floors. The level sets the order: -1 = basement, 0 = ground floor, 1 = 1st floor.

plaene.text: Upload the plans under “Uploaded PDF plans” and assign each floor its page. Large plans take a few minutes to prepare; you can keep working in the meantime.

massstab.text: Enter the scale stated in each plan's title block (e.g. 1:100), or click two points with a known distance. Without a scale no travel times can be calculated.

karte.text: On every floor where goods move, draw:
liste: The corridors as paths (“Draw path”): click point by point along the corridors.
Start and destination points (“Add point”): ramp, store, kitchen, wards …
Lifts and stairs as points: on every floor where they stop, choosing the same lift each time.
Connections between building sections, if there are any.
Every point must be attached to a path. Rooms and areas are optional.

stammdaten.text: Transport types (automated guided vehicles, transport staff) with speed, number and shifts, trolley types with the space they need, and the lift times. Example values are filled in. Adjust them to your building and then confirm.

lieferungen.text: Enter what is brought from where to where and when, how often (for example Mon–Fri at 8:00) and whether there is a return trip. To add many deliveries at once, use “Import” on the Deliveries page with an Excel list; the “Excel” button downloads a matching template. Every delivery is checked for a route.

ergebnis.text: The timeline shows the trips on the map, the analysis shows waiting times and bottlenecks. Scenarios let you try out changes without touching the current state.

problem.plan_fehler: {stockwerk}: the plan could not be prepared ({fehler}).
problem.punkt_ohne_weg: “{name}” ({stockwerk}) is not attached to a path.
problem.uebergang_offen: The connection “{name}” ({stockwerk}) does not lead to another floor yet.
problem.aufzug_ein_halt: “{aufzug}” is only drawn on {stockwerk}. Place it on every floor where it stops.
problem.stockwerk_getrennt: {stockwerk} is not connected to the rest of the network. A lift, stairs or a connection is missing.
problem.punkt_getrennt: “{name}” ({stockwerk}) lies on a path that is not connected to the rest of the network.
problem.zu_wenig_punkte: There are only {anzahl} start or destination points, at least 2 are needed.
problem.anzahl_unbegrenzt: “{name}”: the number is unlimited and there are no shifts. Missing vehicles or staff will not show up as a bottleneck.
problem.aufzug_nicht_eingezeichnet: “{aufzug}” is not drawn on any map.
problem.lieferung_weg_unterbrochen: “{lieferung}”: on {stockwerk} the path from “{von}” to “{nach}” is interrupted.
problem.lieferung_keine_verbindung: “{lieferung}”: reachable from “{von}”: {erreichbar}. “{nach}” is on {ziel_stockwerk}; a connection to it is missing (lift, stairs or building connection).
problem.lieferung_aufzug_nicht_erlaubt: “{lieferung}”: {transportart} may not use {aufzuege}, and there is no other route from “{von}” to “{nach}”.
problem.lieferung_weg_gesperrt: “{lieferung}”: the route from “{von}” to “{nach}” is blocked for {transportart}.
problem.lieferung_kein_weg: “{lieferung}”: there is no route from “{von}” to “{nach}”.
problem.lieferung_punkt_fehlt: “{lieferung}”: a start or destination point was deleted.

ersteinrichtung.text: First create the administrator account. You will use it to manage buildings, plans and further users.

karte.kein_stockwerk: Choose a floor on the left.
karte.keine_gebaeude: No buildings yet. The “Getting started” page guides you through the setup.
karte.kein_plan: There is no plan for this floor yet.
karte.plan_wartet: The plan is waiting to be prepared …
karte.massstab_hilfe: Click two points whose distance you know, e.g. the ends of a dimensioned wall.
karte.massstab_frage: How many metres are between the two points?
karte.massstab_nicht_gefunden: Usually in the title block, e.g. “1:100”. It could not be read automatically, enter the number after the colon.
karte.massstab_original: This is only correct if the PDF was saved at original size (this page: {format}{breite} × {hoehe} mm). Afterwards check the scale with “Measure distance” on a dimensioned wall.
karte.massstab_oder: Or if the plan states no scale:
karte.massstab_messen: Click two points with a known distance
karte.massstab_gespeichert_pruefen: Scale 1:{wert} saved. Check it with “Measure distance” on a dimensioned wall.
karte.messen_hilfe: Click points. Double-click or Esc ends the measurement.

gebaeude.name: Name
gebaeude.ebene_hilfe: Number for sorting: -1 = basement, 0 = ground floor, 1 = 1st floor …
gebaeude.keine_teile: No building sections yet. Add one first, e.g. “Building A”.
gebaeude.plan_gewechselt: Paths, points or rooms are already drawn on “{name}”. If the new plan is positioned differently (shifted, other scale), align them with the “Align” tool in edit mode.

dokumente.hinweis: Large plans are no problem. They are converted into map tiles once, which can take a few minutes.

benutzer.aus_verzeichnis_hilfe: Signs in with the Windows password. The role comes from the AD groups.
benutzer.rolle_aus_verzeichnis: Is set again from the AD groups at the next sign-in.

einstellungen.sondertage_hilfe: For example local holidays, carnival Monday or days with reduced operation. Delivery rules treat them like public holidays.
einstellungen.sprache_hilfe: Default for everybody. Each user can choose their own language in the menu at the top right.
einstellungen.sitzung_inaktiv: Sign out after … hours without use
einstellungen.sitzung_ad: Active Directory users must sign in again after at most … hours
einstellungen.protokoll_tage_hilfe: 0 = unlimited. Older entries are deleted daily.

fehler.keine_berechtigung: You are not allowed to do this.
fehler.anmeldung_falsch: User name or password is wrong.
fehler.zu_viele_versuche: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a minute.
fehler.passwort_zu_kurz: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
fehler.benutzername_ungueltig: The user name may only contain letters, digits and . _ @ -
fehler.bereits_eingerichtet: Logistik Map has already been set up.
fehler.letzter_admin: At least one active administrator must remain.
fehler.datei_zu_gross: The file is too large (max. 1 GB).
fehler.kein_pdf: The file is not a PDF.
fehler.seite_ungueltig: This page does not exist in the PDF.
fehler.dokument_in_verwendung: The PDF is still used as a plan. Remove the plan from the floors first.
fehler.in_verwendung: This is still in use (e.g. by a delivery) and cannot be deleted.
fehler.knoten_in_verwendung: This point is used by a delivery. Change or delete the delivery first.
fehler.transportart_in_verwendung: This transport type is still used by deliveries.
fehler.wagentyp_in_verwendung: This trolley type is still used in deliveries.
fehler.zu_wenige_punkte: An area needs at least three points.
fehler.parent_ungueltig: An area cannot belong to itself.
fehler.laenge_noetig: Please enter the length in metres for connections between floors.
fehler.uhrzeit_ungueltig: Please enter a time in the format HH:MM.
fehler.start_gleich_ziel: Start and destination must be different.
fehler.rueckweg_uhrzeit_fehlt: Please enter a time for “return later”.
fehler.knoten_unbekannt: A point of the delivery no longer exists.
fehler.kein_weg: No route from “{start}” to “{ziel}”. Is a path segment missing, a path blocked or the lift not allowed for this transport type?
fehler.transportart_fehlt: The transport type no longer exists.
fehler.kein_zugang_verzeichnis: Sign-in succeeded, but no role is assigned to your account in Logistik Map. Please contact the administration.
fehler.verzeichnis_nicht_erreichbar: The sign-in server (Active Directory) cannot be reached.
fehler.passwort_im_verzeichnis: Your password is managed in Active Directory (Windows password).
fehler.systemrolle: Built-in roles cannot be changed or deleted.
fehler.rolle_in_verwendung: This role is still assigned to users.
fehler.https_beide_dateien: Please enter certificate and key (or leave both empty).
fehler.sicherung_ungueltig: This is not a valid Logistik Map backup.
fehler.update_nicht_moeglich: The update cannot be installed automatically here.
fehler.update_pruefsumme: The checksum of the downloaded update does not match. Aborted.
fehler.nichts_rueckgaengig: There is nothing to undo on this floor.
fehler.rueckgaengig_nicht_moeglich: This cannot be undone because a delivery now uses the point.
fehler.zu_wenige_passpunkte: Please give at least two pairs of points.
fehler.passpunkte_gleich: The points must not be on top of each other.
fehler.passpunkte_auf_einer_linie: The points are on one line – please choose points further apart.
fehler.kein_plan: There is no plan for this floor.
fehler.datei_unlesbar: The file cannot be read. Please save it as .xlsx or .csv.
fehler.spalten_fehlen: Columns are missing. Required are at least Bezeichnung, Start, Ziel and Uhrzeit – easiest is to export with “Excel” and use that as a template.
fehler.rueckgaengig_fremd: The last change on this floor was made by {benutzer}. You can only undo your own changes.

knoten.name: Name
knoten.kapazitaet: At most at the same time
knoten.kapazitaet_hilfe: For ramps, goods receipt or issue: how many trolleys can be loaded or unloaded here at the same time? Empty = unlimited.
knoten.kapazitaet_text: At most {anzahl} at the same time while loading/unloading

kante.name: Name
kante.laenge_hilfe: Empty = calculated from the plan. Only fill in if the path is longer than the straight line.
kante.kapazitaet: At most at the same time
kante.kapazitaet_hilfe: Bottleneck: how many trolleys fit through at the same time? Empty = unlimited.

hilfe.auswahl: Click an element to edit it. Points can be dragged. Del deletes.
hilfe.weg: Click point by point along the corridors. Existing points and paths snap. Double-click or Esc ends the line.
hilfe.punkt: Click where the point should be (ramp, store, ward, lift …).
hilfe.rechteck: Click two opposite corners of the room.
hilfe.vieleck: Click the corners. Clicking the first point or double-clicking closes the area. Backspace removes the last point.
hilfe.ausrichten_alt: New version of the plan? Click a drawn point or corner ({anzahl} pairs, at least 2, better 3 far apart).
hilfe.ausrichten_neu: Now click where this point is on the new plan.

editor.massstab_zuerst: Set the scale first, otherwise routes cannot be calculated.
editor.kein_weg_in_der_naehe: No path nearby – please connect it with “Draw path”.
editor.aufzug_hilfe: Only for lifts and stairs: all points with the same lift are connected across all floors.
editor.aufzug_waehlen: Please choose or create a lift or stairs.
editor.aufzug_angelegt: Lift created. Set travel times and capacity under master data.
editor.uebergaenge_hilfe: For passages between building sections, bridges or ramps. Lifts don't need this.
editor.uebergang_dialog_hilfe: Connects this point to a point on another floor or in another building section.
editor.keine_punkte_anderswo: There are no named points on other floors yet.
editor.rueckgaengig_hilfe: Undo the last change on this floor (Ctrl+Z)
editor.ecke_hilfe: Drag to move the corner, double-click to delete it
editor.fremde_aenderung: {benutzer} has just changed this floor – the map was reloaded.

rueckweg.label: After unloading
rueckweg.spaeter: return later at a fixed time

regel.ausnahmen_hilfe: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD, separated by commas
regel.zusatztage_hilfe: Also takes place on these dates

lieferung.keine: No deliveries yet. A delivery says what is brought, when, from where to where and how often. Add one with “Add delivery” or take over an Excel list with “Import”.
lieferung.erst_punkte: First add start and destination points on the map (“Edit” mode).
lieferung.name: Name
lieferung.spaetestens_hilfe: Optional. If the goods arrive later, the trip counts as late.
lieferung.zwischenstationen_hilfe: Optional: points the route must pass (e.g. a particular lift). Otherwise the fastest route is used.

stamm.transportarten_hilfe: Who or what transports, how fast and how many there are. These values are the basis for travel times and bottlenecks.
stamm.aufzuege_hilfe: Lifts are placed on the map as points at every stop. Capacity and times are set here.
stamm.wagentypen_hilfe: How much space a trolley needs in a lift (1 = one standard space).
stamm.name: Name
stamm.geschwindigkeit_hilfe: Pushing a trolley about 0.8–1.2 m/s, AGVs often 0.5–1.0 m/s.
stamm.wagen_pro_fahrt_hilfe: How many trolleys one vehicle or person moves at once.
stamm.anzahl_hilfe: 0 = unlimited. Otherwise trips wait until a vehicle is free (also after the return trip).
stamm.aufzug_exklusiv: Reserves the lift exclusively (AGV: staff must leave the car)
stamm.plaetze_hilfe: How many standard trolleys fit in at the same time? 0 = unlimited.
stamm.tuerzeit_hilfe: Opening, getting in or out and closing – counted twice.
stamm.anfahrt_hilfe: Until the lift arrives, also because of passenger traffic.
stamm.raeumzeit_hilfe: Extra time until people have left when an AGV reserves the lift.
stamm.erlaubt_fuer_hilfe: Nothing ticked = all may use it.
stamm.aufzug_zeit: {etage} s/floor, door {tuer} s, wait {anfahrt} s, clearing {raeum} s
stamm.platzbedarf_hilfe: In lift spaces, e.g. 1 for a linen trolley, 2 for a pallet.
stamm.schichten_hilfe: Optional. If shifts are entered, their number applies instead of the fixed number above. Outside all shifts nobody is available.

ablauf.info: {lieferungen} deliveries · {fahrten} trips · {unterwegs} on the way now

auswertung.hilfe: Simulates all deliveries of the chosen day and shows where it gets tight. Filters narrow down the trips; the simulation always uses all of them.
auswertung.gefiltert: The figures refer to the filtered trips. Bottlenecks and utilisation apply to the whole day.
auswertung.keine_engpaesse: No bottlenecks: nobody waits longer than a minute, nothing is 90 % utilised.
auswertung.keine_fahrten: There are no deliveries on this day.
auswertung.szenario_aktiv: You are looking at a scenario. The small numbers show the current state for comparison.
auswertung.vergleich_gleich: No difference to the current state.
auswertung.vergleich_besser: In the scenario there is {zeit} less waiting in total than in the current state.
auswertung.vergleich_schlechter: In the scenario there is {zeit} more waiting in total than in the current state.
auswertung.woche_hilfe: Each cell is one hour: number = trips, colour = longest wait. A click opens the day.

engpass.schlange: Up to {anzahl} waiting at the same time
engpass.zu_gross: {anzahl}× a load did not fit into the car

tipp.aufzug: Ideas: spread delivery times, allow another lift (via point), check trolleys per trip.
tipp.kante: Ideas: draw an alternative route or stagger the trips.
tipp.knoten: Ideas: more loading spaces or stagger the deliveries.
tipp.fahrzeuge: Ideas: more vehicles or staff at this time, or spread the trips.

recht_hilfe.ansehen: View map, deliveries, timeline and analysis, download exports.
recht_hilfe.lieferungen: Add, change and import deliveries; maintain and apply scenarios.
recht_hilfe.bearbeiten: Upload plans, buildings and floors, draw paths and points, change master data.
recht_hilfe.verwalten: Users and roles, settings, backup, updates, Active Directory sign-in, audit log.

rolle.hilfe: A role bundles permissions. The built-in roles (Administrator, Planner, Viewer) cannot be changed; your own roles can.
rolle.name: Name

sicherung.hilfe: Logistik Map backs up the database every day and all PDF plans once a week (in the data folder under “sicherungen”). “Download backup” and “Back up now” always contain everything.
sicherung.wirklich: Restore “{name}”? All data will be replaced by the state of the backup. The current state is backed up first.
sicherung.eingespielt: Backup of {zeit} restored. The plans are being prepared again.
sicherung.fehlende_plaene: These PDF plans are missing and must be uploaded again: {liste}

update.aktuell: Logistik Map is up to date.
update.keine_verbindung: GitHub cannot be reached (no internet connection from the server?). Updates can also be installed manually.
update.wirklich: Install version {version} now? Logistik Map will be unavailable for about a minute.
update.laeuft: The update is being installed. The page will reload afterwards …
update.zeitueberschreitung: The update is taking unusually long. Please reload the page later or check update.log in the data folder.

ldap.hilfe: Staff sign in with their Windows account. The role results from group membership. Local users keep working.
ldap.server_hilfe: e.g. ldaps://dc01.hospital.local – several separated by commas
ldap.domaene_hilfe: Appended to the user name: user@domain

https.hilfe: For an encrypted connection Logistik Map needs a certificate with private key in PEM format, ideally issued by your IT.
https.schluessel: Private key (PEM file on the server)
https.datei_hilfe: Leave both fields empty to switch HTTPS off. Takes effect after a restart.
https.gespeichert: Saved. The change takes effect after a restart.
https.neustart_frage: Restart Logistik Map now? Everybody will be disconnected for a few seconds.
https.neustart_laeuft: Restarting … You will be redirected shortly:

protokoll.hilfe: All changes with time and user.

import.zusammenfassung: {gesamt} rows: {neu} new, {geaendert} will be changed, {fehler} with errors.
import.erst_korrigieren: Please correct the marked rows in the file and import again. Nothing is applied until all rows are correct.

fehler.rueckweg_ungueltig: Return: leer, beladen, später or keiner

szenario.hilfe: A scenario is a copy of the current state with changes: other delivery times, a lift under maintenance, more staff … The real data stays unchanged until you apply a scenario.
szenario.uebernehmen_frage: Apply the changed deliveries from “{name}” to the current state? Changes to lifts and transport types are not applied.
szenario.name: Name
szenario.name_beispiel: e.g. linen at 7:30, west lift under maintenance
szenario.editor_hilfe: Only change what should be different in the scenario. Changed fields are highlighted.
szenario.transportarten_hilfe: A changed number applies to the whole day in the scenario (instead of the shifts).
szenario.rampen_hilfe: How many trolleys can be loaded or unloaded at the same time (empty = unlimited).
szenario.engstellen_hilfe: Named path segments and bottlenecks, e.g. a door closed for construction work.
szenario.keine_engstellen: No named path segments yet. Give path segments a name in the map editor to be able to block them here.
